name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth client ID
setupSteps: In the Canva Developer Portal, create a new integration; who it is for can't be changed later. If your Canva team is on an Enterprise plan, choose Private, which only your team's members can connect. Otherwise choose Public: it works for development, but can't pass Canva's review for release to all Canva users, because design generation and background removal are preview APIs.
Under Authentication, add the redirect URL below.
Under Scopes, enable the scopes this gatekeeper requests: design:meta:read, design:content:write, asset:read, asset:write, folder:read, profile:read.
Copy the integration's Client ID here, then generate a Client Secret and copy that below.
